definition: פֶּתַע substantive suddenness ( √ unknown: compare Assyrian ina pitti, ina pittimma , in suddenness , instantly , Dl HWB 553 ): — Num 35:22 . . . הֲדָפוֺ וְאִםבְּֿפֶתַע if he have thrust him in suddenness , before he is aware what he has done (i.e. accidentally); + פִּתְאֹם Num 6:9 וכי ימות מת עליו בפתע פתאם i.e. very suddenly; לְפֶתַע according to ( לְ , p. 5 I 6 b) suddenness , Isa 29:5 והיה לפתע פתאם = at an instant , suddenly, Isa 30:13 שִׁבְרָהּ אשׁר פתאם לפתע יבוא . As adverb accusative, suddenly , Prov 6:15 (= Prov 29:1 ) פֶּתַע יִשָּׁבֵר , Hab 2:7 .
